notes.title: Devlog notes - Part 5
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone, let’s get right into it without any unnecessary chit-chat.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]First thing, HUGE THANKS FOR 2,000 WISHLISTS![/b][/h2][p]Many may think that it's not a lot, especially compared to AA/AAA studios, where those wishlist numbers are simply incomparable. For us 2000 is a lot and we did it pretty much without any marketing on our end. We achieved this through hard work and by occasionally participating in events. This is a huge step for us and of course a big motivator. So thank you, to the single one of you who added The Flat to the wishlist and follow us on our journey.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/3b630a002099c0e547c005a7fa0db3fde519475a.gif"][/img][/p][p]Now, with that addressed, let’s move on to what was done on the project.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Battery / Quest / Placement[/b][/h2][p]You might’ve already seen it on our Discord channel (this isn’t exactly shining new), but as we mentioned in the last updates, we skipped one month and now we are backtracking a bit.[/p][p]It looks like simple mechanics in a GIF, and it is pretty simple - pick it up, plug it in and something is on 😀 but there will go a lot more into finding the battery, carrying it back to a correct place and then knowing us, we will probably make it a little bit harder to enable whatever it enables. Maybe some puzzle?
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/48dbfe5da92ba6b14c61c5d810b4d38f944edb09.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New “character” for the journey[/b][/h2][p]I guess you can check the WIP model for now. Maybe you can figure out the differences between this guy and other Enons. I mean, it is quite visible right from the first look, but maybe you can find out something more about him.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/a9f36a3b06688196b24737c18df03a6c6e7b7279.png"][/img][/p][p]He is in the game already and he is not “just there”, I think it is safe to say that he left some mark and impression behind and it can be up to you to re-discover it. I don’t want to say too much, but it is really dope![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Archive room polish[/b][/h2][p]Malaria still polishes the Archive Room, making it look a little bit “meaner”. Many other parts of the map are getting the same treatment and there is an active quest to make it look as good as possible.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/9fd80db564225f2dc5e0133c1af7a0969968235a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]ASAP Man teleport[/b][/h2][p]It is no secret that ASAP Man, which is one of the few main characters, has a role that hasn’t been shown as much. You were able to see a lot of “Enons”, but only a few mentions of ASAP Man, and we believe it is a good thing and it should stay like that :D However, I think everyone can see that he has a bit of a Boss vibe to him. And as all bosses, they must be everywhere on time to make sure everyone else is working on time. So Malaria cooked a cool animation for exactly that.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/6d275f85803d53ab8756397927073bc90cda7510.gif"][/img]
[/p][p]Finally, as always, we would like to express our gratitude for your help and support. Seeing mentions of The Flat on social media and getting an influx of new wishlists means a lot to us. We hope to grow further and deliver even more stunning visuals and code each week.[/p][p][/p][p]So once again, thanks a lot! <3[/p]

notes.title: Devlog notes - Part 4
notes.notes:
[p]Welcome to another monthly update. Even though our last one was in April – we know we are late. We were always open about the fact that The Flat is being worked on besides our full time jobs and personal life and sometimes, there is just no time. But enough shit talking, let’s dive deep into what you missed XD[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Opening scene[/b][/h2][p]We are a bit obsessed with live level menus here and even though we do not have a main menu– just yet, we do have an opening scene. The idea is to make this whole thing reactive and interactive, but let’s leave this to your imagination now.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/f71f85189e628eaa7fac6bfac0015b5998f3ea21.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Archive room[/b][/h2][p]The Flat is made out of mean looking places. Mean looking = not supposed to look like flowers and rainbows, but a dangerous and brutal environment, pretty much the one you would find working in a corporation XD Another location here created by Malaria is the Archive Room. As with everything we try to add, all will be serving a purpose.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/783b9d49ec4f6cba30ca679b9da4f7a25342a6d0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New device[/b][/h2][p]The next new thing is 'the device' (not its official name). I would love to tell you as much as I can about it, but I think Malaria will kill me if I do. It's better not to spoil too many things — it'll be much more interesting and fun to let you experience this one for yourself! :)[/p][p][/p][p]All is textured and ready to go. I hope to code everything once I have a bit more time.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/db78453f3822f03417d2d4dbbf050e8bf32a6976.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Mechanic table at work[/b][/h2][p]Last but not least is the mechanic table. It got some extra love and you can now see how it looks like with the full animation and in the level. All there is left to do is just to hook it all up in the code.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/4d16c420487e9c54d1e14c3e646da9ec1c58a180.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]On the closing note[/b][/h2][p]It's never easy to summarize everything that's going on in a project. However, we are making steady progress and are already shaping the release date.
[/p][p]We have both been extremely busy, but we remain committed to The Flat and its development. The next step is to rework the code, adding props and optimization. We are working with an old codebase that I don't understand very well, and, to be honest, we are experiencing significant performance issues that we have linked to NPC AI. Luckily, I’ve gained some valuable experience and we have no intention of stopping.
[/p][p]Meanwhile, Malaria is ensuring that the world continues to evolve, updating the visuals and lore and writing the story. Marketing is slowly coming into view, but I think we’ll feel more confident about tackling it once we have more to show.[/p][p][/p][p]Although this isn’t a promise, I hope that we’ll show you more behind-the-scenes code as soon as I have something cool. Until then, let's continue with our weekly updates on Discord and our monthly updates here as usual.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for the love and support![/p][p]Spreading the word is much appreciated! <3
[/p]

notes.title: Devlog notes - Part 3
notes.notes:
Another month of dedicated development passed and we are bringing another news about The Flat. There have been some visual updates but also some code updates.

[h2]Eye Animation[/h2]
It is no news that The Eye will play some role in the game apart from the visual one. We don’t want to spoil way too much and take away the fun part, but we want to make sure that it will look (and work) epic. That is why Michał “Malaria” added new animations for The Eye.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/c43c3932a282223f24c2cf011fabd62d3773738a.gif[/img]

Once we begin to work on implementing the features, we’ll be sure to post some snippets here and there. So I recommend you to follow our [url=https://discord.gg/qMyCVT3jVr] Discord [/url].

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Broken ENON Conveyor Belt[/h2]

With the evolution of quests and storyline, more models are needed. And those models need for sure to fit the style of The Flat. Over the months, when looking back at the beginnings, we can see what has been added and honestly it does keep me amazed, how much more this world can grow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/8d383edcedc89e89aed0ec1a1ecc4d8d94fcbb74.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/709375946825dec2f8a467a50d91e07ec34e279e.gif[/img]

Visuals are the key part of The Flat and we are making sure that players can explore every corner of the map and find some clues to their answers regarding what The Flat is and what it is trying to say.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Mechanics Table[/h2]

Another new addition to the pool of models is the Mechanics Table. As it is with the majority of the models, this one will also not serve only as a visual element, but will have some role in the gameplay. As eager as I am to share more details, I don’t want to spoil fun and after all, all this might still change along the way 😀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/b49ce5b95fb8622c13f380bf674dfd4e3776c941.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Mechanics[/h2]

Although we don’t have the visual material for the Mechanics part, I still want to take a few lines and write about what is happening, so you know we don’t do only visuals, but work on the back end as well.

Inventory has been nearly completed. We are talking about a bit more advanced inventory that works with multiple UI elements all together and changes aspects of the camera too. It will not serve only as “Press E to open” and “Select, Remove, Use”. But will offer much more than that, think of it as a HUB to all details of the world.

[h2]Riddle[/h2]

Here, I cannot say more as the riddle is an essential part of the game. All I can say is that this is something “new” that I haven’t seen much of before. Malaria came with this idea, and we were able to wrap it up rather quickly. Still... Some polishing is left to be done, but in my eyes, it is pretty near to being done.

[h2]Other stuff[/h2]

We have plenty of other stuff that we are doing in the back end. From tweaking older mechanics, to changing them all together, or rewriting code that I jumped into. One must realize that jumping into the codebase of someone else is no easy task especially since everything is pretty inter-connected. Just know, we are trying our best to not sit still and bring this game closer to being released.

[hr][/hr]

We appreciate all your support, thanks for wishlisting and following the game. Each share of the page helps tremendously, with more wishlists, we get more freedom and that can change the direction of the game ❤️

See ya next month!

notes.title: Devlog notes - Part 2
notes.notes:
After a month and our promise we pledged to you all, we are coming with another content update for The Flat. Quite a few things happened in the past month and we are excited to share those with you in as much detail as we can.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Battery Holder[/h2]

Without giving away too much information, Battery Holder is an essential part of the game and will play a major role in the gameplay. That’s why it needs to look sexy and fit the surroundings. We were playing out with some concepts and different versions, but in the end Malaria managed to create this detailed piece. From a white cube, I would call it a major improvement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/cadc075dc198dd973bf56c5478c0e7a9173c0b3f.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Trash Bin with Enons[/h2]

Another item that might or might not play some role in the gameplay is the Trash Bin with Enons (the main and common enemy in The Flat). We are toying with some ideas as to what we can do with this, but it might as well stay just as a static object that will mainly play a posing philosophical question, rather than serving a gameplay purpose, but will see :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/c90f1e689b211457f4804930f4d7f569179741b2.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Inventory and new UI[/h2]

Long overdue but it is slowly coming together. We have just added an inventory into The Flat. With visualization fitting the style of the game, we came up with this semi-transparent screen that spans out of your Keyboard. It is still very much in progress, but once everything is connected, I believe it will be worth the wait. Multiple elements are connected with the inventory and as we know, the Keyboard is more than a keyboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/712ffbbe14c2ac27d6047d6d6a52347cb03af6d3.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]New riddle[/h2]

The Flat already has some riddles that the player needs to solve, but we are always looking into ways to make things more interesting. Drawers riddle will be something unique and we hope it will be truly something that players will enjoy. The work is yet to begin, but we already have a pretty strong foundation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/d6f18a1281d577ce4f290cb272e845be3aa288fa.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Summary[/h2]

The development of The Flat is going really well! :) The world and level content are expanding, and in just a month, another update will be posted here. However, if you’d like to stay up to date even more, we share weekly updates every Friday on [b]https://discord.com/invite/qMyCVT3jVr[/b]

Cheers!

notes.title: Devlog notes - Part 1
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

The time has come to finally share a bit more about the development process of The Flat. For those of you following us on [url=https://discord.gg/qMyCVT3jVr]Discord[/url] you probably already know that we post small updates there every Friday. However, we've been pretty quiet here, and I’ll be honest—it’s not because we didn’t want to share. It’s just that between development and life, there wasn’t much time to write a full post, and for a while, we didn’t have many exciting things to show in full. But that’s changed. As we approach the demo release in the coming months, we’re excited to let you in on what’s been happening in The Flat.

This project has been through a lot. Development started back in late 2022, and since then, we’ve gone through countless prototypes, concepts, and changes. So much has been added and evolved that it feels like the right time to give you a peek.

Right now, we’re in the polishing phase, adding a few last touches to get the demo ready. The game is evolving rapidly, and we’re pushing hard to make everything feel just right. This post is a bit of a summary—a look at where the project began, how it’s changed, and where it’s headed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/8b3e0f8ed58e33e8e4ad6d0fae43e706ca32a184.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]From idea to reality[/h3]

Like most projects, The Flat started with a big idea. We wanted to figure out what The Flat should be and what kind of story we wanted to tell. We definitely wanted the world to be minimalistic, carry its own atmosphere, and at the same time offer addictive gameplay.

At first we wanted to create a completely different game, with a procedural way of creating maps, RPG elements, and everything in a dark Slavic climate. We tried to put together a team of friends from the industry: three people with a background in graphics and engine knowledge, plus one programmer, and someone handling marketing. A total of five people. But the scale of that original idea was way too ambitious for the time and resources we had. So, we took a step back, reimagined everything, and The Flat idea was somehow born.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/4cd02c232b97160feecdde51d2af729eea199e78.png[/img]

We downsized our small team to just one person handling graphics, one for programming, and the occasional involvement of the marketing specialist. The initial idea was simple: a game set inside the player’s apartment, with occasional trips outside into the larger world. The flat itself would be a kind of hub—a base to return to after exploring. But as we played with the concept, it evolved into something much bigger and more visually striking. It changed completely and we left just a few bits of the very first gameplay ideas we had for the game and I personally believe it was the right path to go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/2805a5e3f8e0c7a528e63092793453e2afcf89d8.png[/img]

The current version of The Flat is very visual-heavy, with a dark, brutalist aesthetic and a mix of humor and absurdity in its story. The idea of being trapped in a corporate machine—a cog in a never-ending grind— like Steam description states, really resonated with us, especially since many of us have experienced corporate life firsthand. It just clicked. That’s why you’ll find little jokes, absurd letters, and references scattered throughout the game, poking fun at the ridiculousness and stupidity of it all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/65c12b7b957aed6060a540d27768bc24b02220db.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Inspiration[/h3]

The inspiration behind The Flat ties back to our experiences and how we see the world (I guess?)—how things work (or don’t work), and corporations being just a symbol. When it came to designing levels, weapons, characters, and the overall vibe, we let our imaginations run wild. We also asked for feedback on our discord channel, which is how a weapon like the paper guillotine was created XD

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/42018a1dbded52a5ab26b9bf9d53d9a1c2d9959d.png[/img]

I remember when we started working on The Flat Michał asked me, "What do you think about brutalist architecture? I think it’s pretty cool," and I replied that it was actually a great idea to use it. I’ve decided to combine the visual design with the Fibonacci spiral and add a corporate antagonist in a suit, with a monitor for a head, who would scream "ASAP!" And that’s how the idea of The Flat and ASAP-MAN was born.

A few months later, we found out about something called Skibidi toilet. However, we knew we wanted to tell a different story. Trusting the creative process, we kept designing new enemies, architectural elements, mechanics, and devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/047739cb6e75be9ea50a8be9575cb325259dc160.png[/img]

Beyond That we drew inspiration from pinterest, books, movies and just a lot of daydreaming. The jokes and quirky details, though? Those came straight from our own imaginations or –unfortunately– real life experiences 😀 or philosophical debates about reality during a cigarette break, between daily work, working after hours and moments to sleep or eat.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Gameplay Loop and Mechanics[/h3]

At its core, the gameplay loop in The Flat is simple but engaging. Originally, it was about exploring a maze-like world, fighting enemies, gathering items, and returning to your flat to figure out why all this was happening. While the overall concept has changed, the spirit of exploration and survival remains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/5e57b19d917187d3e73a99b615bdbd671571ff65.gif[/img]

Now instead, you’re a cog in the corporate machine. You’re trying to understand the surroundings while battling enemies and navigating the absurdity of corporate life.

Your primary weapon at the start is a keyboard (yes, a literal keyboard), but you can also use pretty much anything you find—boxes, cups, pipes—you name it. We’ve added an air dash mechanic too, so you can evade enemies or slow down time to sneak past them. Whether you prefer combat or stealth, the game gives you the freedom to play your way.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Level Design and Lighting[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/64a568945a3b40117966e5f4c1c4cfc7cc7f536e.png[/img]

Creating the levels and lighting has been one of our biggest challenges. We wanted something atmospheric, dark, and gritty, and I think we’re getting close to nailing it. The lighting sets the mood perfectly, and the brutalist architecture really sells the world we’ve built.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/b17f98afa55c1631b4eadca9d3a3c848d4f5716d.png[/img]

It wasn’t easy getting here. We went through countless revisions, experimenting with post-processes and natural and artificial light to create the right atmosphere. Some areas feel stark and grim, while others have a different tone altogether.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Looking Ahead[/h3]

This post is just an introduction—a way to share what The Flat is and how it’s grown over time. Going forward, we’d love to post updates here monthly, diving deeper into the technical aspects, new features, and changes as we approach the final stages of development.

To everyone who’s wishlisted and followed the game—thank you. It means so much to us, and it genuinely helps the algorithm. If you believe in what we’re creating, please share The Flat with your friends. It makes a huge difference, especially since we’re a small team of three (and most of the game was made by just two!).

We can’t wait to hear your thoughts once the demo drops, and we hope we can live up to your expectations. Thanks for being part of this journey with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485308/ef29d1bec0840b8ef77b5f60a96b6c47cfb2c9f4.png[/img]
